vocab_words.example: The staff were courteous and helpful.
The team worked to resolve the issue quickly.
The warehouse conducts inventory checks monthly.
The shipment is expected to arrive next week.
Defective items are returned to the manufacturer.
We switched to a more reliable supplier.

vocab_words.meaning: hậu cần, công tác vận chuyển
vocab_words.example: The logistics team coordinates all deliveries.
The factory upgraded its assembly line last year.
The company plans to upgrade its software system.
A malfunction caused the server to shut down.

items.question: Employees are required to submit their timesheets ___ Friday afternoon.
items.explanation: "By" mang nghĩa hạn chót (deadline) — phải nộp trước hoặc đúng thời điểm đó.

items.question: Employees who arrive late ___ notify their supervisor immediately.
items.explanation: Động từ khiếm khuyết "should" đi với động từ nguyên mẫu không "to".

items.question: The new software update improves the system's ___ significantly.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ (noun) sau tính từ sở hữu "the system's".

items.question: The manager insisted that the report ___ revised before submission.
items.explanation: Sau "insist that" trong câu giả định trang trọng, dùng động từ nguyên mẫu "be".

items.question: Customers can track their orders ___ our new mobile application.
items.explanation: "Through" nghĩa là thông qua, bằng phương tiện gì.

items.question: The workshop will be held ___ further notice.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "until further notice" nghĩa là cho đến khi có thông báo mới.

items.question: The company remains committed ___ delivering high-quality products.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be committed to + V-ing/danh từ".

items.question: The manager asked her assistant ___ the documents before the meeting.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "ask someone to do something".

items.question: ___ the delay, the project was completed under budget.
items.explanation: "Despite" + cụm danh từ, không phải mệnh đề đầy đủ như "although".

items.question: The department head ___ several changes to improve efficiency.
items.explanation: Câu cần động từ chia ở thì hiện tại hoàn thành để diễn tả hành động vừa xảy ra.
